description: This file implements an IRC bot class 'CommitAnnouncer' that monitors Git commits and posts updates to an IRC channel, along with a threading wrapper 'CommitAnnouncerThread'. It includes methods for handling IRC events, updating the repository, and formatting commit details.

classes.name: CommitAnnouncer
classes.description: An IRC bot class that announces new Git commits to a specified IRC channel, with methods for handling IRC events, updating the repository, and formatting commit details.

classes.name: CommitAnnouncerThread
classes.description: A threading wrapper that runs the CommitAnnouncer bot in a separate thread.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the IRC bot with repository path, IRC credentials, and command handlers.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.start
methods.description: Starts the bot after performing an initial update.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.post_new_commits
methods.description: Checks for new commits since last known commit and posts details to IRC.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.help
methods.description: Posts available commands to IRC.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.ping
methods.description: Responds with 'Pong.' to IRC ping.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.stop
methods.description: Stops the bot with an optional message.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.on_nicknameinuse
methods.description: Handles nickname conflicts by appending an underscore.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.on_welcome
methods.description: Joins the IRC channel upon connection.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer.on_pubmsg
methods.description: Processes public messages for commands.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._update
methods.description: Updates the local Git repository, handling clean tracking and retries.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._time
methods.description: Returns formatted current time.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._message_command
methods.description: Parses message for command invocation.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._should_announce_commit
methods.description: Determines if a commit affects the specified announce path.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._commit_detail
methods.description: Retrieves and formats commit details.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._format_commit_detail
methods.description: Formats commit detail string with URL, author, subject, and flags.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._post
methods.description: Sends a message to IRC channel.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncer._sanitize_string
methods.description: Encodes message to ASCII with backslash replacements.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncerThread.__init__
methods.description: Initializes thread with a CommitAnnouncer instance.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncerThread.run
methods.description: Starts the IRC bot in a thread.

methods.name: CommitAnnouncerThread.stop
methods.description: Stops the bot and joins the thread.
